authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13846 sphuṇṭati/sphuṇḍate gives Bashkarik phuṇḍ flower, Chiliss phundo and Shina phuṇu. These Kohistani phūṇ/phū̃ṇḍ forms fit the documented nasal flower family; the deeper verbal-root alternative remains qualified. Exact survey form pʰū̃ṇḍ is preserved.

assignments.Notes: CDIAL 13846 sphuṇṭati/sphuṇḍate gives Bashkarik phuṇḍ flower, Chiliss phundo and Shina phuṇu. These Kohistani phūṇ/phū̃ṇḍ forms fit the documented nasal flower family; the deeper verbal-root alternative remains qualified. Exact survey form pʰū̃ṇḍ is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11625 vikāla explicitly gives Gawarbati yel night and Torwali byäl, Chiliss biyāli and Shina byāle yesterday. Bashkarik/Bateri biāl fits the same regional yesterday family; the article also has Bashkarik žāl and leaves regional transmission open. Exact survey form bīāl is preserved.
